## Stennos Darker Desert
Simply darkens the textures of Sand and Sandstone Blocks to be easier on the eyes while Desert Mining. **This is a Utility Pack** and not meant to be used regularly.


---


## Features
- Makes the following blocks darker: `chiseled_sandstone`, `cut_sandstone`, `sand`, `sandstone`, `sandstone_bottom`, `sandstone_top` <sup>[[1]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/darkerdesert/gallery)</sup>
- This also makes Smooth Sandstone darker, since Minecraft uses `sandstone_top` on all sides
- This does not effect Suspicious Sand; this makes it easier to spot as an unintended consiquence
- **Note:** This is a utility pack, meant for simple and easy on the eyes mining. This is not part of a main pack, as the colors do not fit with any other game textures; your builds will be very strange if you leave this on when you're not mining. I recommend keeping this as a stand-alone utility pack.
- No other changes, you get what is described and no other mystery modifications to bug you
- <sup>Initially designed for use in [Streams](https://www.twitch.tv/stennos) & [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Stennos) videos by [Stennos](https://linktr.ee/Stennos)</sup>


<details>
<summary>Install</summary>

- **Option 1:** Click "Download" button > Install with Modrinth App
- **Option 2:** Download > Launch Minecraft: Java Edition > Resource Packs Menu > Open Resource Packs Folder > Copy Resource Pack Downloaded Zip file here > Resource Packs Game Menu > Click Arrow to move “**Stennos Darker Desert**” to the right side

</details>
